Poached Pears ~ Party Perfect
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, May 15, 2010 - 10:11am

Ingredients




4 pears (peeled, halved & cored)
1 bottle of wine (which ever kind you like)
1/2 cup sugar
aromatics - vanilla, cinnamon, fresh whip cream or ice cream

Preparation

1 Place wine, aromatics, 1/2 cup of sugar & pears into a pot. Bring up to a simmer for 10-20 minutes depending on size of the pears. 2 When a fork slips into pears easily remove from heat & allow to cool in liquid. 3 Once tepid - place the pears in to the fridge, leaving the juices in the pan. 4 Continue cooking the liquid until reduced by half and forms a syrup. Taste the syrup - if its tart add a bit more sugar. 5 Allow the syrup to cool once desired consistency is achieved. Strain out aromatics. 6 Server syrup drizzled over pears with a scoop of gelato or whip cream!

About


A beautiful simple dessert absolutely perfect for a dinner party. Use that bottle of wine that's been collecting dust in the back of your cupboard (you know the one) - it will work great in this classic dish!
